era_context: 美索不达米亚的古巴比伦时期；埃及第十二王朝晚期；印度河流域文明衰落后期；中国商朝早期；黎凡特第一青铜时代。这一时期代表了几个成熟文明的最后几十年，以及新的政治和文化格局的出现。

events.title: 汉谟拉比的统治：旧巴比伦国家的巩固
events.description: 随着巴比伦在美索不达米亚南部的权力的巩固，汉谟拉比的统治继续进行。在此期间，巴比伦已经成为该地区的主要政治和军事力量，击败了拉尔萨和亚述等敌对城邦。 《汉谟拉比法典》，无论是在今年还是之后不久颁布，都是汉谟拉比努力在整个王国建立统一的法律和行政体系的结晶。 随着巴比伦在美索不达米亚南部的权力的巩固，汉谟拉比的统治继续进行。在此期间，巴比伦已经成为该地区的主要政治和军事力量，击败了拉尔萨和亚述等敌对城邦。该法典涉及财产权、贸易、家庭关系和刑事司法，反映了一个具有独特社会阶层的复杂城市社会。

events.title: 印度河流域文明：最终衰落与文化转型

The Indus Valley Civilization was in its final phase of decline during this period. Major urban centers such as Mohenjo-daro and Harappa were largely abandoned or occupied only at reduced levels. The standardized administrative systems, weights, measures, and undeciphered script that had characterized the civilization were no longer in use. Trade networks had contracted significantly.

sources.name: Archaeological excavations and stratigraphy from Indus sites

events.certainty_note: The decline of the Indus Valley Civilization is well-documented archaeologically. Radiocarbon dating and stratigraphic analysis place the civilization's decline c. 1900–1700 BCE, with this year falling within that range. The civilization's end is confirmed by multiple lines of archaeological evidence.

events.title: Egyptian 12th Dynasty: final years and transition to Second Intermediate Period
events.description: The 12th Dynasty of Egypt was in its final years during this period. The reign of Amenemhat III (if traditional dating is correct, r. c. 1860–1814 BCE) was marked by extensive building projects and administrative achievements, but the dynasty's power was waning. Provincial governors were accumulating autonomy, and the central government's ability to control the entire Nile Valley was diminishing.
